sentences.en: And as we do that, we are closing in here on the show on the issues that really seem to be driving and defining the election in the key swing states that will ultimately determine
sentences.zh: 在倒计时的同时，我们节目组正在聚焦那些似乎真正驱动并定义了关键摇摆州选举的议题，这些州最终将决定

sentences.en: whether Donald Trump or Kamala Harris wins the White House.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普还是卡玛拉·哈里斯能入主白宫。

sentences.en: And Jenny, you have been reporting out of Nevada.
sentences.zh: 珍妮，你一直在内华达州进行报道。

sentences.en: So just to begin with, put that state into the broader electoral picture for us.
sentences.zh: 首先，请为我们把该州放在更广阔的选举版图中来看。

sentences.en: So we're in a coin flip election nationally, and Nevada really is a coin flip state.
sentences.zh: 从全国来看，这是一场胜负难料的选举，而内华达州确实是一个胜负难料的州。

sentences.en: At this point, either party could win by just the slimmest of margins.
sentences.zh: 目前，任何一方都可能以极其微弱的优势获胜。

sentences.en: And that's interesting because Democrats have really counted on Nevada for their wins for the last 20 years.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为过去20年来，民主党一直指望内华达州来赢得选举。

sentences.en: The last Republican to win was George Bush in 2004.
sentences.zh: 上一位获胜的共和党人是2004年的乔治·布什。

sentences.en: And when Obama won in 2008, Nevada was a major victory for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而当奥巴马在2008年获胜时，内华达州是民主党的一场重大胜利。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And has remained ever since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后一直如此。

sentences.en: Basically, Democrats have never lost it since 2004.
sentences.zh: 基本上，自2004年以来，民主党从未在这里输过。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a lot of Democrats thought that that heralded this future for them, that they were the party of diversity, that they were the party of the working class.
sentences.zh: 许多民主党人认为这预示了他们的未来，认为他们是多元化的政党，是工人阶级的政党。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And in a lot of ways, no state epitomized that more than Nevada, where the overwhelming majority of voters do not have a college degree.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，没有哪个州比内华达州更能体现这一点，那里绝大多数选民都没有大学学位。

sentences.en: There's a very large Hispanic population, and there's also a really significant Asian and
sentences.zh: 那里有非常庞大的拉美裔人口，还有非常显著的亚裔和

sentences.en: Black population.
sentences.zh: 黑人人口。

sentences.en: And so for Democrats, it's a state that matters not only for its six electoral votes, but maybe even more so for its symbolism.
sentences.zh: 因此对于民主党来说，这个州不仅因为其六张选举人票而重要，甚至更因为其象征意义。

sentences.en: And it's also a place that Democrats worry about every single cycle, because they keep eking out these wins, but by an increasingly shrinking margin.
sentences.zh: 而且这也是民主党每个选举周期都感到担心的州，因为他们虽然一直勉强获胜，但优势却越来越小。

sentences.en: Okay, and what does Nevada mean to Republicans in this moment?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么内华达州在此时对共和党意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think for Republicans, it's a lot of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为对于共和党人来说，情况大同小异。

sentences.en: There is this symbolism that it represents for them.
sentences.zh: 它对他们来说具有某种象征意义。

sentences.en: Trump has spent a lot of time in Nevada, both this year and in the 2020 cycle, and he has a lot of devotees there.
sentences.zh: 特朗普今年和2020年选举周期都在内华达州花了很多时间，他在那里有很多拥护者。

sentences.en: And there's also this idea that's been percolating, and we've seen for four years now, of Trump making inroads with working class voters who are not white.
sentences.zh: 而且还有一种酝酿已久的想法，我们已经观察了四年，那就是特朗普正在争取非白人背景的工人阶级选民。

sentences.en: Trump did well with many of these voters in 2020 and might do even better this time around.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在2020年赢得了许多这类选民的支持，这次可能表现得更好。

sentences.en: And so for Trump, if he wins this prize of Nevada, he'll be able to say, look, I am helping us become the party of the working class.
sentences.zh: 所以对于特朗普来说，如果他赢下了内华达这个奖项，他就能说，看，我正在帮助我们成为工人阶级的政党。

sentences.en: I am helping us become a more diverse party.
sentences.zh: 我正在帮助我们成为一个更加多元化的政党。

sentences.en: You all criticize me for these things that I say and accuse me of being racist, but I'm actually getting more of these voters who you thought were never possible.
sentences.zh: 你们都因为我说的这些话而批评我，指责我是种族主义者，但我实际上正在争取到你们认为绝不可能争取到的选民。

sentences.en: And based on the time that you've spent there, what is the animating issue for voters in Nevada this year?
sentences.zh: 根据你在那里的时间，今年内华达州选民最关心的议题是什么？

sentences.en: Without question, the animating issue is the economy.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，最关心的议题是经济。

sentences.en: This is a place that has always had a lot of boom and bust cycles, but COVID completely obliterated the Las Vegas economy.
sentences.zh: 这个地方一直经历着许多繁荣与萧条的周期，但新冠疫情彻底摧毁了拉斯维加斯的经济。

sentences.en: It really hurt a lot of people, and we're still seeing the effects of that.
sentences.zh: 它确实伤害了很多人，我们至今仍能看到其影响。

sentences.en: And when we talk about the economy now, what voters say first is housing, just how much it costs to live there.
sentences.zh: 当我们现在谈论经济时，选民首先提到的是住房，也就是在那里的生活成本有多高。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That doesn't necessarily surprise me because we've talked so much on the show about the nationwide housing crunch.
sentences.zh: 这并不让我感到意外，因为我们在节目中已经谈论了很多关于全国性的住房紧缩问题。

sentences.en: And put simply, it's that there is not enough housing and the housing that exists is too expensive.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，就是住房供应不足，而现有的住房又太贵了。

sentences.en: What exactly is the picture of the housing problem in Vegas?
sentences.zh: 拉斯维加斯的住房问题到底是什么情况？

sentences.en: I tend to think of it as a place actually with a tremendous amount of housing.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于认为它实际上是一个拥有大量住房的地方。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Traditionally, Vegas has been exactly that.
sentences.zh: 传统上，拉斯维加斯正是如此。

sentences.en: The thing to know about Las Vegas is that it was this sprawling place where people flocked to for their little slice of the American dream.
sentences.zh: 关于拉斯维加斯，需要知道的是，它曾经是一个广阔的地方，人们涌向这里，寻找属于自己的美国梦。

sentences.en: It's really an exciting time for all of us here in the Valley because of all those new developments, especially for homebuyers.
sentences.zh: 对于我们山谷里的所有人来说，这确实是一个激动人心的时刻，因为有了所有这些新开发项目，尤其是对购房者而言。

sentences.en: You can even see with this...
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以看到……

sentences.en: It was a big expanse of desert.
sentences.zh: 它曾经是一片广阔的沙漠。

sentences.en: There were always new houses being built.
sentences.zh: 总是有新的房子在建造。

sentences.en: Clark County coming in at number two on the list of the hottest zip codes across the country.
sentences.zh: 克拉克县在全国最热门邮编地区名单中排名第二。

sentences.en: And people could afford those houses without having a huge salary.
sentences.zh: 人们不需要高薪就能买得起那些房子。

sentences.en: As long as you get on the right websites and you find the right postings, you can find housing pretty much within a week.
sentences.zh: 只要你找对网站，找到合适的房源，基本上在一周内就能找到住处。

sentences.en: But during and after the pandemic, that really started to shift.
sentences.zh: 但在疫情期间及之后，情况真的开始转变了。

sentences.en: A home buying frenzy happening now in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 拉斯维加斯正在掀起一股购房狂潮。

sentences.en: Local realtors say the pandemic has dramatically changed the local housing market.
sentences.zh: 当地房地产经纪人表示，疫情极大地改变了当地的住房市场。

sentences.en: You had a lot of people moving in to Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 很多人搬到了拉斯维加斯。

sentences.en: It's a gorgeous area.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常美丽的地方。

sentences.en: Everybody seems nice.
sentences.zh: 每个人看起来都很友善。

sentences.en: And it's a lot cheaper to live here than California.
sentences.zh: 而且住在这里比在加州便宜得多。

sentences.en: 150,000 people moved to Nevada from California alone.
sentences.zh: 仅从加州搬到内华达州的人就有15万人。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 真令人着迷。

sentences.en: Housing prices in Las Vegas continue to skyrocket.
sentences.zh: 拉斯维加斯的房价持续飙升。

sentences.en: So you had rents going up, interest rates going up, and all of a sudden, this place that was once affordable started to feel just like California, like the very places people were
sentences.zh: 所以你看到租金上涨，利率上涨，突然之间，这个曾经负担得起的地方开始变得和加州一模一样，就像人们

sentences.en: trying to leave.
sentences.zh: 试图逃离的地方一样。

sentences.en: And just how expensive does housing become in the state?
sentences.zh: 那么该州的住房变得有多贵？

sentences.en: So when we're talking about the state, what we're really focusing on is Clark County,
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论这个州时，我们真正关注的是克拉克县、

sentences.en: Vegas, and all the surrounding suburbs.
sentences.zh: 拉斯维加斯以及所有周边的郊区。

sentences.en: 70% of the population of Nevada lives in Clark County.
sentences.zh: 内华达州70%的人口居住在克拉克县。

sentences.en: We're just trying to talk to people about their business and the economy in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想和人们聊聊他们在拉斯维加斯的生意和经济状况。

sentences.en: Do you mind if we ask you a couple questions?
sentences.zh: 介意我们问你几个问题吗？

sentences.en: I've spent a lot of time over the last year talking with voters in Clark County.
sentences.zh: 过去一年里，我花了很多时间与克拉克县的选民交谈。

sentences.en: And a couple of weeks ago, I went back with Daily Producers,
sentences.zh: 几周前，我和《每日新闻》的制片人

sentences.en: Carlos Prieto and Claire Tennis-Gedart, to hear from voters about what the housing crisis has looked like.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·普列托和克莱尔·坦尼斯-盖达特一起回去，听取选民关于住房危机的情况。

sentences.en: Do you mind if we ask you a couple questions?
sentences.zh: 介意我们问你几个问题吗？

sentences.en: And what did you find?
sentences.zh: 你们发现了什么？

sentences.en: A two-bedroom, it is $1,200 a month.
sentences.zh: 一套两居室，一个月要1200美元。

sentences.en: So just last year, I was paying $700.
sentences.zh: 就在去年，我才付700美元。

sentences.en: Basically, everybody that you talk with will tell you a story about how much their rent has increased.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你交谈的每个人都会告诉你一个关于他们的租金涨了多少的故事。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And they'll explain that compared to what they were paying in 2019 or even 2021,
sentences.zh: 他们会解释说，与2019年甚至2021年支付的租金相比，

sentences.en: their rent has effectively doubled or even tripled today.
sentences.zh: 他们现在的租金实际上翻了一番甚至两番。

sentences.en: Do you remember what your rent, what they wanted to increase it to?
sentences.zh: 你还记得你的租金，他们想涨到多少吗？

sentences.en: Almost $3,000, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想差不多3000美元。

sentences.en: They had been around $1,300.
sentences.zh: 之前大约是1300美元。

sentences.en: Remember five years ago, you could rent a house, a house for $725.
sentences.zh: 记得五年前，你可以租一栋房子，一栋房子只要725美元。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And now for $1,200, all you can get is a studio.
sentences.zh: 而现在1200美元只能租到一间单间公寓。

sentences.en: People talk about signing six-month leases and watching their rent go up at least $100 every six months.
sentences.zh: 人们谈论着签署六个月的租约，并看着他们的租金每六个月至少上涨100美元。

sentences.en: So how much of your income goes to bills and rent specifically?
sentences.zh: 那么你的收入中有多少比例专门用于账单和房租？

sentences.en: Basically, all of it.
sentences.zh: 基本上，全部。

sentences.en: Literally, all of it.
sentences.zh: 确实，全部。

sentences.en: People talk about looking for houses for months or even years on end and not being able to afford the down payment.
sentences.zh: 人们谈论着寻找房子几个月甚至几年，却负担不起首付。

sentences.en: Everybody has that story of housing woe.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有那种住房困境的故事。

sentences.en: Actually, when I got over here, I was very young.
sentences.zh: 其实，我刚到这里的时候，我还很年轻。

sentences.en: So I was able to work hard with my ex-husband and buy a house.
sentences.zh: 所以我能够和前夫努力工作，买了一套房子。

sentences.en: And now it's like, you can't do that.
sentences.zh: 而现在，你根本做不到。

sentences.en: So we ended up visiting somebody who really typifies what a lot of people are going through in Las Vegas, who feels like that dream of Las Vegas has not materialized for him.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最终拜访了一个人，他真正代表了拉斯维加斯许多人的经历，他觉得拉斯维加斯的梦想并没有为他实现。

sentences.en: It has not been a bridge to the middle class.
sentences.zh: 它并没有成为通往中产阶级的桥梁。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: How are you, Jenny?
sentences.zh: 你好吗，珍妮？

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: His name is Armando Garcia.
sentences.zh: 他叫阿曼多·加西亚。

sentences.en: He's 26 years old, and we met him at the rental home he shares with his partner, two roommates, and a few pets.
sentences.zh: 他今年26岁，我们在他与伴侣、两名室友和几只宠物合租的租赁房屋里见到了他。

sentences.en: We sat down in his living room, which is a very simple space.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在他的客厅里，那是一个非常简单的空间。

sentences.en: There's not a lot of decorations or furniture around.
sentences.zh: 周围没有太多的装饰或家具。

sentences.en: There's just a Dungeons & Dragons game on the coffee table.
sentences.zh: 咖啡桌上只有一套《龙与地下城》游戏。

sentences.en: And remind me again, I know you told me, but I can't recall.
sentences.zh: 再提醒我一下，我知道你告诉过我，但我记不起来了。

sentences.en: How much do you pay for rent here total?
sentences.zh: 你这里的房租总共付多少钱？

sentences.en: The base rent is $2,000, and then water and trash can fluctuate from like $200 to $400.
sentences.zh: 基本租金是2000美元，然后水费和垃圾费会在200到400美元之间波动。

sentences.en: And then electricity and gas we pay separately from our rent, and that fluctuates even more.
sentences.zh: 电费和燃气费我们是和房租分开付的，波动更大。

sentences.en: And tell me a little bit about how hard it is or isn't to make rent.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说付房租有多难，或者说有多不难。

sentences.en: It's been difficult.
sentences.zh: 一直很困难。

sentences.en: Currently at my job, I work $20 an hour plus commission, and my other roommates also work like $16 an hour to $20 an hour.
sentences.zh: 目前我的工作时薪是20美元加提成，我的其他室友时薪也大约在16到20美元之间。

sentences.en: One of them works salary, and we're still like struggling to keep up with our rent.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人拿固定工资，我们仍然在为支付房租而挣扎。

sentences.en: And he started telling us about his life and this difficult housing saga he's been going through.
sentences.zh: 他开始向我们讲述他的生活，以及他正在经历的这场艰难的住房传奇。

sentences.en: My dad's from Acapulco, and my mom's from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸来自阿卡普尔科，我妈妈来自墨西哥。

sentences.en: Armando's parents are both from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 阿曼多的父母都来自墨西哥。

sentences.en: They moved to San Diego, where he was born.
sentences.zh: 他们搬到了圣地亚哥，他在那里出生。

sentences.en: My family moved to Las Vegas in the summer of 2005.
sentences.zh: 我的家人在2005年夏天搬到了拉斯维加斯。

sentences.en: My uncle was opening up a sandwich shop, and he wanted my dad to help with the business, so we moved here.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔当时要开一家三明治店，他想让我爸爸帮忙打理生意，所以我们就搬到了这里。

sentences.en: And when they first got there, Armando remembers it being a lot more difficult than his parents had hoped or expected it would be.
sentences.zh: 当他们刚到那里时，阿曼多记得生活比他父母希望或预期的要困难得多。

sentences.en: My dad was working as a cook, and then I remember my parents started cleaning banks at night.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸当时做厨师，然后我记得我父母开始在晚上打扫银行。

sentences.en: They worked multiple jobs, and they were also constantly struggling to figure out how to pay the rent.
sentences.zh: 他们打好几份工，而且一直在为如何支付房租而苦恼。

sentences.en: But they kept encouraging him to try to do what they couldn't.
sentences.zh: 但他们一直鼓励他尝试做他们做不到的事情。

sentences.en: And my parents were like, you should try to buy a house.
sentences.zh: 我父母总是说，你应该试着买一套房子。

sentences.en: They kept saying, even from the time he was a teenager,
sentences.zh: 他们一直这么说，甚至在他十几岁的时候就开始了。

sentences.en: Armando, buy a home, buy a home.
sentences.zh: 阿曼多，买套房吧，买套房。

sentences.en: You can do it.
sentences.zh: 你可以做到的。

sentences.en: Buy a home.
sentences.zh: 买套房。

sentences.en: And then he decides to move out of his parents' house and in with roommates.
sentences.zh: 然后他决定搬出父母家，和室友合租。

sentences.en: And then I started working at the call center, which was $16 an hour.
sentences.zh: 后来我开始在呼叫中心工作，时薪是16美元。

sentences.en: He has what he describes as a pretty decent-paying job.
sentences.zh: 他有一份他自认为薪水还不错的工作。

sentences.en: And that was insane.
sentences.zh: 那简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And he feels like it's pretty stable.
sentences.zh: 而且他觉得这份工作相当稳定。

sentences.en: I had the ability to make a savings.
sentences.zh: 我有能力存点钱。

sentences.en: And he thinks he might be able to put enough money away to actually be able to do what his parents keep encouraging him to do, to buy a home.
sentences.zh: 他觉得也许能攒够钱，去实现父母一直鼓励他做的事——买房。

sentences.en: But then COVID happened.
sentences.zh: 但后来新冠疫情爆发了。

sentences.en: But then the pandemic comes.
sentences.zh: 接着大流行病来了。

sentences.en: And he's working a pizza delivery job.
sentences.zh: 他开始做披萨外送的工作。

sentences.en: And he shuffles through a couple of jobs.
sentences.zh: 他断断续续换了几份工作。

sentences.en: And the apartment, they increased the rent every single month.
sentences.zh: 公寓的租金每个月都在涨。

sentences.en: And at the same time, his rent keeps going up higher and higher each month.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他的房租每个月都在不断上涨。

sentences.en: And the bills feel further and further out of reach.
sentences.zh: 账单感觉越来越难以负担。

sentences.en: And then I had to, like, use my credit cards more so that I would have cash.
sentences.zh: 后来我不得不更多地使用信用卡，这样我才有现金可用。

sentences.en: So he's living paycheck to paycheck and racking up debt.
sentences.zh: 所以他过着入不敷出的生活，债务越积越多。

sentences.en: So I got to the point where I was just like, I'm not paying my credit cards.
sentences.zh: 我到了那种地步，心想，我不还信用卡了。

sentences.en: I'm just keeping the money that I have to pay for food and rent.
sentences.zh: 我只想留着手里的钱来支付伙食费和房租。

sentences.en: And this keeps going on for a while.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了一段时间。

sentences.en: Eventually, he and his roommates move from the apartment to a house to save a little bit of money.
sentences.zh: 最终，他和室友从公寓搬到了一栋房子里，想省点钱。

sentences.en: But he's still barely making ends meet.
sentences.zh: 但他依然勉强维持生计。

sentences.en: And then earlier this year, things change really quickly.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，情况发生了剧变。

sentences.en: And a lot starts to unravel.
sentences.zh: 很多事情开始失控。

sentences.en: We, three of us had lost our jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们三个都失业了。

sentences.en: And we all had to find jobs within, like, two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在两周内找到工作。

sentences.en: He loses a job and is without a paycheck for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 他丢了工作，两周没有收入。

sentences.en: And for him and for his roommates, that's really catastrophic.
sentences.zh: 对他和他的室友来说，这简直是灾难性的。

sentences.en: They fell behind on rent very quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们很快就拖欠了房租。

sentences.en: Their landlord took them to eviction court.
sentences.zh: 房东把他们告上了驱逐法庭。

sentences.en: They come back with an eviction order.
sentences.zh: 他们拿到了驱逐令。

sentences.en: And so then we kind of just had, like, a week.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时大概只有一周的时间。

sentences.en: And they're all really preparing to have to leave the home.
sentences.zh: 他们都在为不得不搬离住所做准备。

sentences.en: So he put everything in storage.
sentences.zh: 于是他把所有东西都放进了仓库。

sentences.en: And it's really scary for them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说真的很可怕。

sentences.en: He tried to comfort one of his roommates, who was just really freaked out and kind of panicking, thinking that she might be either couch surfing or living in her car.
sentences.zh: 他试图安慰其中一位室友，她当时非常惊恐，甚至有些崩溃，担心自己要么去借宿沙发，要么只能睡在车里。

sentences.en: I remember, like, every day for two weeks, I had to, like, hold her while she cried.
sentences.zh: 我记得有两周时间，我每天都得抱着哭泣的她。

sentences.en: She just, she could not imagine what a future would look like where we were homeless.
sentences.zh: 她简直无法想象如果我们无家可归，未来会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And it ended up being where I had to borrow $1,000 from my mom, $1,000 from my uncle to make three months of rent.
sentences.zh: 最后我不得不向我妈借了1000美元，向我叔叔借了1000美元，才凑够了三个月的房租。

sentences.en: So they barely escape eviction.
sentences.zh: 所以他们勉强逃过了被驱逐的命运。

sentences.en: And really, the only way they managed to do so is because Armando cobbles together some small loans from two different family members.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们能做到这一点，全靠阿曼多从两位不同的家人那里东拼西凑借来了一些小额贷款。

sentences.en: But Armando's really shaken.
sentences.zh: 但阿曼多真的被吓到了。

sentences.en: Like,
sentences.zh: 就像是，

sentences.en: he's gone from thinking a few years ago that it was possible for him to buy a house to now realizing that he's in just as a precarious position or an even more precarious position than his parents were ever in.
sentences.zh: 他几年前还觉得买房是有可能的，而现在他意识到，自己所处的境地和父母当年相比，甚至更加岌岌可危。

sentences.en: And to the degree that the American dream has always been grounded in this idea that you will do better than your parents, this has to be exceptionally disillusioning.
sentences.zh: 如果说“美国梦”一直建立在“你会比父母过得更好”这一理念之上，那么现在的现实一定让人极度幻灭。

sentences.en: Yes, and that dream that he had inherited from his parents of buying a house has completely vanished.
sentences.zh: 没错，他从父母那里继承的那个买房梦想已经彻底破灭了。

sentences.en: Do you want to move out to your own place with your partner at some point?
sentences.zh: 你以后想过和伴侣搬出去住吗？

sentences.en: Is that a dream?
sentences.zh: 那是一个梦想吗？

sentences.en: Hmm, it'd be nice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那当然好。

sentences.en: But I think the dream of having my own home is not a dream I've had since I was 21.
sentences.zh: 但我认为拥有自己的房子这个梦想，从我21岁起就不再有了。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Because I think it just feels too bold to have that dream.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得拥有那个梦想显得太奢侈了。

sentences.en: I could dream and in the dream, hypothetically, like we're stable enough to own it.
sentences.zh: 我可以做梦，在梦里，假设我们足够稳定，能够拥有它。

sentences.en: But like what always kind of like dampens the daydream is that to me now it just feels unrealistic.
sentences.zh: 但总是有些东西会浇灭这种白日梦，因为对我来说，现在这感觉太不现实了。

sentences.en: It doesn't feel like I can like daydream about it for very long because it just feels like I have realism around me all the time.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己没法做太久的白日梦，因为现实感时刻笼罩着我。

sentences.en: And in a lot of ways, his story might sound extreme, but it's really not that unique.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，他的故事听起来可能很极端，但其实并不罕见。

sentences.en: We spoke to a local real estate agent in Vegas who grew up there and had seen all of this up close.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了一位在拉斯维加斯长大的当地房地产经纪人，他近距离见证了这一切。

sentences.en: And he said that for most people who work in Las Vegas without a college degree, what used to be attainable, what used to be very possible, no longer is.
sentences.zh: 他说，对于大多数在拉斯维加斯工作且没有大学学位的人来说，曾经触手可及、非常可能实现的目标，现在已经不再可能了。

sentences.en: You just can't get what your parents might have been able to get 10 or 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 你就是无法得到你父母在10年或20年前可能得到的东西。

sentences.en: This is what is infuriating many people who live in Las Vegas and have lived here for years.
sentences.zh: 这让许多在拉斯维加斯生活多年的人感到愤怒。

sentences.en: There are people all over Las Vegas and other parts of the country who are really struggling with this basic idea of making rent or finding a place to live for good.
sentences.zh: 在拉斯维加斯和全国其他地方，有很多人都在为支付房租或寻找一个安身之所这一基本问题而苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: Even parents who I speak with who own a home worry constantly that their kids won't have a place to live.
sentences.zh: 即使是那些有房的父母，也经常担心他们的孩子将来没有地方住。

sentences.en: It's a really basic thing that we often take for granted, but that many people are now struggling with more than before.
sentences.zh: 这是一件我们经常视为理所当然的基本需求，但现在很多人却比以往任何时候都更难实现。

sentences.en: And so for those people, they're looking at this presidential election through the lens of a housing crisis.
sentences.zh: 因此，对这些人来说，他们正透过住房危机的视角来看待这次总统大选。

sentences.en: They're not worried about anything else to the degree that they are worried about finding a place to live comfortably and stably.
sentences.zh: 他们对其他任何事情的担忧，都比不上对能否找到一个舒适、稳定的住所的担忧。

sentences.en: And so what they want to know is, how can you address this?
sentences.zh: 所以他们想知道的是，你们打算如何解决这个问题？

sentences.en: Are you going to do anything to change my basic experience of living in America?
sentences.zh: 你们会采取什么行动来改变我在美国生活的基本体验吗？

sentences.en: Can you possibly restore my faith in the American dream even?
sentences.zh: 你们甚至能恢复我对美国梦的信心吗？

sentences.en: Because I think when you don't have a stable place to live, it really shatters your faith in that.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得当你没有一个稳定的住所时，你对这一切的信心就彻底破碎了。

sentences.en: It really makes you question what the government is doing and what kind of safety and stability there is in this country.
sentences.zh: 这真的会让你质疑政府在做什么，以及这个国家还有什么样的安全感和稳定性可言。

sentences.en: And that's a real challenge that Donald Trump and Kamala Harris face in making their case to voters right now.
sentences.zh: 这正是唐纳德·特朗普和卡玛拉·哈里斯目前在争取选民支持时面临的真正挑战。

sentences.en: They're trying to navigate this level of frustration and distrust in two very different ways.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图以两种截然不同的方式来应对这种程度的挫败感和不信任感。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: So Jenny, given the dynamics that you just outlined, how has the presidential race, the campaign, played out in Nevada?
sentences.zh: 那么珍妮，考虑到你刚才概述的情况，总统竞选在内华达州是如何展开的？

sentences.en: So there is absolutely no ignoring the presidential campaign in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 在内华达州，总统竞选是绝对无法忽视的。

sentences.en: Their Bidenomics led to the highest inflation in 40 years.
sentences.zh: 他们的“拜登经济学”导致了40年来最高的通货膨胀。

sentences.en: Everywhere you go, any restaurant you're in where there is a TV on.
sentences.zh: 无论你走到哪里，任何开着电视的餐馆里。

sentences.en: Kamala Harris va a luchar por nosotros.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯会为我们而战。

sentences.en: La decisión está clara?
sentences.zh: 决定很明确了吗？

sentences.en: You see an ad from one candidate or another.
sentences.zh: 你总能看到某位候选人的广告。

sentences.en: Extremists are attacking abortion rights.
sentences.zh: 极端分子正在攻击堕胎权。

sentences.en: Kamala's for they, them.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉支持“他们”群体。

sentences.en: President Trump is for you.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统支持你。

sentences.en: There are billboards everywhere, every radio station.
sentences.zh: 到处都是广告牌，每个广播电台都在播。

sentences.en: We need Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 我们需要卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: You're going to be fed some sort of political ad.
sentences.zh: 你总会被灌输某种政治广告。

sentences.en: I'm Donald J.
sentences.zh: 我是唐纳德·J·特朗普，我批准了这条信息。

sentences.en: Trump, and I approve this message.
sentences.zh: 特朗普，我批准了这条信息。

sentences.en: And the candidates have come in and out of the state multiple times.
sentences.zh: 候选人们已经多次往返于这个州。

sentences.en: Hello, Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 你好，拉斯维加斯。

sentences.en: Hello, Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 你好，拉斯维加斯。

sentences.en: And every single time they come, they're there to talk about the economy.
sentences.zh: 而且他们每次来，都是为了谈论经济问题。

sentences.en: We had the greatest economy in history.
sentences.zh: 我们曾拥有历史上最伟大的经济。

sentences.en: And for Donald Trump, he has really hammered home the message that this is Democrats' fault.
sentences.zh: 对于唐纳德·特朗普来说，他确实一直在强调这是民主党的错。

sentences.en: People are saying to themselves, were we better off four years ago or are we better off now?
sentences.zh: 人们在问自己，我们四年前过得更好，还是现在过得更好？

sentences.en: And it wasn't even close.
sentences.zh: 答案显而易见。

sentences.en: That any economic pain that you are feeling is because something that Democrats did or did not do.
sentences.zh: 你所感受到的任何经济痛苦，都是因为民主党做了或没做什么。

sentences.en: We also need to build more housing in America.
sentences.zh: 我们还需要在美国建造更多的住房。

sentences.en: And Harris, for her part, has been a little bit more specific.
sentences.zh: 而哈里斯这边，则稍微具体了一些。

sentences.en: So we will cut the red tape and work with the private sector to build three million new homes.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将消除繁文缛节，与私营部门合作建造三百万套新房。

sentences.en: She has gone out there and given speeches a couple of times talking about how much more housing needs to be built.
sentences.zh: 她已经多次发表讲话，谈论需要建造更多的住房。

sentences.en: Provide first-time homebuyers with $25,000 down payment assistance.
sentences.zh: 为首次购房者提供2.5万美元的首付援助。

sentences.en: About tax credits and more specific ideas of how she can try to help change the situation.
sentences.zh: 关于税收抵免以及她如何尝试帮助改变现状的具体想法。

sentences.en: So Harris is more explicitly talking about housing in a state where, based on your reporting, housing is the driving issue.
sentences.zh: 所以哈里斯在明确谈论住房问题，而在你报道的这个州，住房正是核心议题。

sentences.en: Is that disparity in the two candidates' focus on housing mattering?
sentences.zh: 两位候选人在住房问题上的关注度差异重要吗？

sentences.en: And how are voters generally responding to these two competing messages?
sentences.zh: 选民们对这两种相互竞争的信息普遍有何反应？

sentences.en: So, of course, like in every other state, there are people who are just viewing this in the same way they always have, in a partisan lens.
sentences.zh: 当然，就像在其他州一样，有些人还是像往常一样，戴着党派的有色眼镜来看待这一切。

sentences.en: There are the people who voted for Trump and will stick with him again.
sentences.zh: 有投给特朗普的人，他们会继续支持他。

sentences.en: There are people who voted for Biden and are sticking with Harris.
sentences.zh: 有投给拜登的人，他们会继续支持哈里斯。

sentences.en: But there's a small group of people who are not really tuning into this until right now who are undecided.
sentences.zh: 但还有一小部分人，直到现在才开始关注，他们尚未决定。

sentences.en: And they are the people who will matter the most on Election Day.
sentences.zh: 他们才是选举日最关键的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The coveted, persuadable voter.
sentences.zh: 令人垂涎的、可被说服的选民。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: The persuadable voter.
sentences.zh: 可被说服的选民。

sentences.en: And in Las Vegas, that typically means a non-college-educated voter, most likely Black or Latino, and most likely living paycheck to paycheck.
sentences.zh: 在拉斯维加斯，这通常意味着没有受过大学教育的选民，很可能是黑人或拉丁裔，而且很可能过着入不敷出的生活。

sentences.en: And after talking to dozens of these voters in the last several weeks, I think about them as in three different buckets.
sentences.zh: 在过去几周与数十位这类选民交谈后，我认为他们可以分为三类。

sentences.en: And what are those buckets?
sentences.zh: 是哪三类？

sentences.en: The first group of those voters are people who describe themselves as progressives, who have been longtime committed Democrats,
sentences.zh: 第一类选民是那些自认为是进步派、长期忠诚的民主党人，

sentences.en: but now feel like the party has abandoned them and are considering voting for some kind of third-party candidate by writing somebody in.
sentences.zh: 但现在觉得党派已经抛弃了他们，正在考虑通过写下其他人的名字来投票给某种第三方候选人。

sentences.en: And I think Armando, who couldn't afford his rent anymore, he describes himself in just that way.
sentences.zh: 我想阿曼多，那个已经付不起房租的人，他就是这样描述自己的。

sentences.en: Are you voting in this year's election?
sentences.zh: 你今年会参加投票吗？

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: Can I ask you about who you plan to vote for and why?
sentences.zh: 能问问你打算投给谁，为什么吗？

sentences.en: It's difficult.
sentences.zh: 这很难说。

sentences.en: I'd like to vote for the Green Party.
sentences.zh: 我想投给绿党。

sentences.en: Armando says there's a tiny chance he might change his mind and vote for Harris.
sentences.zh: 阿曼多说他有极小的可能改变主意投给哈里斯。

sentences.en: Like a 2% chance.
sentences.zh: 大概2%的几率吧。

sentences.en: But if the election were today, he would write in Jill Stein or somebody else and take a very ideologically committed vote and sort of hope for some kind of political revolution,
sentences.zh: 但如果今天就选举，他会写下吉尔·斯坦或其他人的名字，投下这一神圣的意识形态选票，并寄希望于某种政治革命，

sentences.en: so to speak.
sentences.zh: 可以这么说。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: These are voters who, it seems, are ready to cast a protest vote against the entire system, Democratic and Republican.
sentences.zh: 这些选民似乎准备对整个民主党和共和党体系投下抗议票。

sentences.en: And that's not really that surprising in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 这在内华达州并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Remember, this is where Bernie Sanders won in the 2020 Democratic caucus.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，伯尼·桑德斯就是在2020年民主党预选中赢得了这里。

sentences.en: But it's also the smallest group of these voters.
sentences.zh: 但这也是这些选民中人数最少的一群。

sentences.en: What is the second group?
sentences.zh: 第二类是什么？

sentences.en: The second group is what you might think of as Trump-Turners.
sentences.zh: 第二类你可以认为是“转向特朗普的人”。

sentences.en: These are mostly people who voted for Obama in the past,
sentences.zh: 他们大多是过去投给奥巴马的人，

sentences.en: but felt like his promises of hope and change and the Democratic promise of hope and change has basically been empty for them.
sentences.zh: 但他们觉得，他所承诺的希望与变革，以及民主党所承诺的希望与变革，对他们来说基本上都是空谈。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: There's a lot of this sense of what we face now is worse.
sentences.zh: 现在很多人都有这种感觉，认为我们面临的情况更糟糕了。

sentences.en: We are worse off.
sentences.zh: 我们的处境更差了。

sentences.en: We're going in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 我们正走在错误的道路上。

sentences.en: And maybe we should just go back to what we had under the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 也许我们应该回到特朗普政府时期的状态。

sentences.en: Do you mind if I ask you a couple questions?
sentences.zh: 介意我问你几个问题吗？

sentences.en: That's okay, but I just speak too much English.
sentences.zh: 没关系，但我只会说一点点英语。

sentences.en: It's fine.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: If you want to tell me, answer me in Spanish, that's fine, too.
sentences.zh: 如果你想用西班牙语回答我，也没问题。

sentences.en: For example, we met a woman named Kenya who was selling herbal supplements.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们遇到了一位名叫肯尼亚的女士，她正在卖草药补品。

sentences.en: And she voted for Joe Biden in 2020.
sentences.zh: 她在2020年投票给了乔·拜登。

sentences.en: But she's seen her family struggle financially.
sentences.zh: 但她眼看着家人的经济状况陷入困境。

sentences.en: She says a lot of her family members have been looking for a home for a while and just can't afford to buy one.
sentences.zh: 她说她的很多家人找房子找了很久，却根本买不起。

sentences.en: And she thinks, look, maybe Trump is the better businessman, who can make her bottom line feel better.
sentences.zh: 于是她想，看吧，也许特朗普是个更好的商人，能让她的财务状况好转。

sentences.en: Then we went to a baseball field where I had been just a month before and at that time had spoken to a lot of voters who were undecided.
sentences.zh: 后来我们去了我一个月前刚去过的一个棒球场，当时我采访了很多尚未决定的选民。

sentences.en: But this time, I was surprised by how many people there were very enthusiastically voting for Trump.
sentences.zh: 但这次，我很惊讶地发现有那么多人非常热情地支持特朗普。

sentences.en: I'm a Trump supporter.
sentences.zh: 我是特朗普的支持者。

sentences.en: What do you all like about him?
sentences.zh: 你们都喜欢他哪一点？

sentences.en: What do you see?
sentences.zh: 你们看到了什么？

sentences.en: He's a businessman.
sentences.zh: 他是个商人。

sentences.en: You have to run a country like a business.
sentences.zh: 经营国家就得像经营企业一样。

sentences.en: So who are you voting for in the fall?
sentences.zh: 那么秋天你们打算投给谁？

sentences.en: Probably Trump.
sentences.zh: 大概是特朗普吧。

sentences.en: I'm voting for Trump.
sentences.zh: 我会投给特朗普。

sentences.en: Everybody hates me when I say this, but I would personally vote for Trump.
sentences.zh: 我说这话大家都会讨厌我，但我个人会投给特朗普。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And that's who you're voting for?
sentences.zh: 所以你打算投给他？

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: You're voting for Trump?
sentences.zh: 你要投给特朗普？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I prefer Trump over what we have.
sentences.zh: 比起现在的局面，我更倾向于特朗普。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Basically, they want change.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们想要改变。

sentences.en: And in Trump's message of a broken system that he says he will repair, sounds like they're finding that change.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普关于系统崩溃并承诺修复的言论，听起来正是他们想要的改变。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And Jenny, what's the third group of these persuadable voters?
sentences.zh: 珍妮，这些可争取选民中的第三类群体是什么？

sentences.en: So the third group of voters are kind of the most interesting to me.
sentences.zh: 第三类选民对我来说是最有趣的。

sentences.en: Maria, can I ask you a little bit about politics?
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，我能问你一点关于政治的问题吗？

sentences.en: Will you vote in November?
sentences.zh: 十一月你会去投票吗？

sentences.en: I won't this time.
sentences.zh: 这次我不会投了。

sentences.en: I didn't plan on voting, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我没打算投票。

sentences.en: I don't think I will vote.
sentences.zh: 我想我不会去投票。

sentences.en: You don't think you will vote?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你不会投票？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And those are people who have voted in the past or who at least think about voting.
sentences.zh: 这些人过去投过票，或者至少考虑过投票。

sentences.en: I'm tired of it all.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到厌倦了。

sentences.en: You know, I'm just burnt out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只是精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: But say this time they are just not going to vote at all.
sentences.zh: 但他们说这次他们根本不会去投票。

sentences.en: I am a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 我是民主党人。

sentences.en: Same garbage, different package.
sentences.zh: 同样的垃圾，换了个包装而已。

sentences.en: Democrats and Republicans, they don't do nothing no more for us.
sentences.zh: 民主党和共和党，他们对我们来说什么都不做了。

sentences.en: We met those people at a swap meet.
sentences.zh: 我们在跳蚤市场遇到了这些人。

sentences.en: We met them at grocery stores.
sentences.zh: 我们在杂货店遇到了他们。

sentences.en: I feel like it no matter who we vote for, they're going to choose who they want to choose.
sentences.zh: 我觉得无论我们投给谁，他们最终都会选他们自己想选的人。

sentences.en: To be honest, that's just how I feel.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我就是这么觉得的。

sentences.en: And I've met them again and again over months going to Nevada.
sentences.zh: 过去几个月里，我去内华达州时一次又一次地见到他们。

sentences.en: I just promise things I will say.
sentences.zh: 我只是承诺我会说的话。

sentences.en: It's not that I expect, like, to fix the world, like, in one night or one day.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我指望能在一夜之间或一天之内解决世界难题。

sentences.en: But it's like, I don't see anything.
sentences.zh: 但感觉就是，我什么都没看到。

sentences.en: I don't see nothing coming out for us.
sentences.zh: 我没看到有任何对我们有利的结果。

sentences.en: These are people who have voted for Democrats in the past, but feel like the system just isn't working and just don't see the point anymore.
sentences.zh: 这些人过去曾投票给民主党，但觉得体制根本行不通，也不再觉得有什么意义了。

sentences.en: Just don't feel like there's any reason to do what they've done in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 只是觉得没有理由再做他们过去做过的事。

sentences.en: And sitting out is their form of proteSt.
sentences.zh: 而弃权就是他们表达抗议的方式。

sentences.en: A different form of protest than Armando, for example.
sentences.zh: 这是一种与阿曼多不同的抗议方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A different form of proteSt.
sentences.zh: 一种不同的抗议方式。

sentences.en: They just feel frustrated and want to voice this frustration.
sentences.zh: 他们只是感到沮丧，并想表达这种沮丧。

sentences.en: Is it fair to say that you're not voting because you're angry?
sentences.zh: 可以说你是因为愤怒才不投票的吗？

sentences.en: No, I'm not angry.
sentences.zh: 不，我不是愤怒。

sentences.en: I'm disappointed.
sentences.zh: 我是失望。

sentences.en: I'm disappointed.
sentences.zh: 我感到失望。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Angry?
sentences.zh: 愤怒？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I mean, Jenny, what you're really describing here in all of these encounters you had with voters in Nevada is a profound cynicism, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，珍妮，你在内华达州与选民的所有这些接触中，真正描述的是一种深刻的犬儒主义，对吧？

sentences.en: And it feels deeply connected to their eroding economic circumstances, primarily housing, but it sounds like not just housing.
sentences.zh: 而且这似乎与他们日益恶化的经济状况有着深层的联系，主要是住房问题，但听起来不仅仅是住房问题。

sentences.en: And by and large, what you're finding would seem to generally cut against the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，你的发现似乎普遍对民主党不利。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: I think what I have found over the last several months in Nevada, over this entire year,
sentences.zh: 我认为我在过去几个月，也就是这一整年里在内华达州的发现，

sentences.en: is just a really profound sense of cynicism that is essentially defining the electorate there.
sentences.zh: 就是一种非常深刻的犬儒主义，这基本上定义了那里的选民。

sentences.en: There is so much anger over the economy and so much a feeling of broken promises.
sentences.zh: 人们对经济感到非常愤怒，对破碎的承诺感到非常失望。

sentences.en: People feel very, very frustrated and very, very hopeless.
sentences.zh: 人们感到非常、非常沮丧，非常、非常绝望。

sentences.en: And it hurts people's day-to-day lives.
sentences.zh: 这伤害了人们的日常生活。

sentences.en: What they thought Vegas was supposed to mean for them, what Vegas meant to their families, what Vegas meant for the possibilities, all seems to have evaporated.
sentences.zh: 他们曾经认为维加斯对他们意味着什么，维加斯对他们的家庭意味着什么，维加斯对未来意味着什么，这一切似乎都烟消云散了。

sentences.en: And they lay that, fairly or not, at the feet of Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而且无论公平与否，他们都把这些归咎于民主党。

sentences.en: There's a case to be made that rather than this being a Biden-Harris Democratic Party problem, just based on the fact that they are the incumbent administration,
sentences.zh: 有一个观点是，这不仅仅是拜登-哈里斯民主党的问题，仅仅因为他们是现任政府，

sentences.en: that this cynicism is something that Democrats are struggling with and have been struggling with for a really long time because the Democratic Party does see itself as the party of institutional solutions.
sentences.zh: 这种犬儒主义是民主党长期以来一直在努力应对的问题，因为民主党自视为制度性解决方案的政党。

sentences.en: You know, going all the way back to the New Deal, up through Obamacare.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从新政一直到奥巴马医改。

sentences.en: If you are a cynical voter inclined to distrust the government as the vehicle for solving your problem, then the Democratic brand is one you're very likely to be wary of.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个愤世嫉俗的选民，倾向于不信任政府作为解决问题的工具，那么你很可能会对民主党的品牌保持警惕。

sentences.en: It's a whole lot easier to run against the system.
sentences.zh: 反对体制要容易得多。

sentences.en: And who has better mounted a campaign against the system than Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 还有谁比唐纳德·特朗普发起了更成功的反体制运动？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to remember that many of these voters once believed in that system.
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的是要记住，许多这些选民曾经相信那个体制。

sentences.en: They really believed that government, in fact, they might still believe that government was supposed to have a positive impact in their lives, but they don't feel like it has.
sentences.zh: 他们真的相信政府，事实上，他们可能仍然相信政府本应对他们的生活产生积极影响，但他们觉得并没有。

sentences.en: That's the promise that they feel is broken.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们感到破碎的承诺。

sentences.en: That's what's leading them to their cynicism.
sentences.zh: 这就是导致他们产生犬儒主义的原因。

sentences.en: You say that government is supposed to work for me, and I don't actually see that coming true.
sentences.zh: 你说政府本应为我服务，但我实际上并没有看到这一点实现。

sentences.en: You say that government is supposed to improve my life and my children's life, and in fact, I feel like my children are going to be worse off than I am.
sentences.zh: 你说政府本应改善我和我孩子的生活，但事实上，我觉得我的孩子会比我过得更差。

sentences.en: That sort of overwhelming feeling of things aren't going to get better.
sentences.zh: 那种压倒性的感觉，觉得事情不会好转了。

sentences.en: Things aren't getting better.
sentences.zh: 事情并没有好转。

sentences.en: And this sort of feeling of giving up, of thinking, I keep trying and trying, and it's not getting better.
sentences.zh: 还有这种想要放弃的感觉，觉得我一直在努力，一直在尝试，但情况并没有好转。

sentences.en: So what do I have to lose by just blowing up the system?
sentences.zh: 那么，通过摧毁这个体制，我有什么可失去的呢？

sentences.en: And in Nevada, working class voters, voters without a college degree, and Latino voters are some of the fastest growing segments of voters overall.
sentences.zh: 在内华达州，工人阶级选民、没有大学学位的选民和拉丁裔选民是总体上增长最快的选民群体之一。

sentences.en: And if those voters have become so cynical that they decide to blow up the system, it could mean that Trump wins the state.
sentences.zh: 如果这些选民变得如此愤世嫉俗，以至于决定摧毁这个体制，那可能意味着特朗普会赢得该州。

sentences.en: And that's completely emblematic of what we see going on nationally, of Latino voters voicing frustration over the Democratic Party,
sentences.zh: 这完全象征着我们在全国范围内看到的情况，拉丁裔选民对民主党表达不满，

sentences.en: of working class voters voicing frustration over the Democratic Party, of this feeling that the American dream might be out of reach for people that once really had a possibility.
sentences.zh: 工人阶级选民对民主党表达不满，这种感觉就是美国梦对于曾经真正拥有可能的人来说可能已经遥不可及了。

sentences.en: And if that cynicism becomes a defining feature of this year's election, it will be a big part of what could hand the White House to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 如果这种犬儒主义成为今年选举的一个决定性特征，它将成为可能将白宫拱手让给唐纳德·特朗普的重要因素。

sentences.en: Well, Jenny, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，珍妮，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Sunday night,
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，

sentences.en: a new analysis showed that higher home prices have disproportionately affected Americans in the seven swing states most likely to determine the outcome of the election.
sentences.zh: 一项新的分析显示，房价上涨对最可能决定选举结果的七个摇摆州的美国人造成了不成比例的影响。

sentences.en: The analysis from The Washington Post found that a majority of voters across those seven states, including Nevada, North Carolina, Georgia, and Arizona,
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》的分析发现，这七个州（包括内华达州、北卡罗来纳州、佐治亚州和亚利桑那州）的大多数选民，

sentences.en: face outsized burdens from rising home costs.
sentences.zh: 都面临着住房成本上涨带来的巨大负担。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, any hope that the death of Hamas' leader might help end the region's war quickly evaporated.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，哈马斯领导人死亡可能有助于迅速结束地区战争的任何希望都烟消云散了。

sentences.en: In Israel, a drone from Lebanon crashed near the private residence of Israel's prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, raising the possibility that Hezbollah sought to target him.
sentences.zh: 在以色列，一架来自黎巴嫩的无人机在以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的私人住宅附近坠毁，引发了真主党可能试图针对他的猜测。

sentences.en: In Lebanon, Israel claimed its airstrikes had killed three Hezbollah commanders.
sentences.zh: 在黎巴嫩，以色列声称其空袭炸死了三名真主党指挥官。

sentences.en: And in Gaza, Palestinian authorities said that a major Israeli airstrike had killed or wounded dozens of people.
sentences.zh: 在加沙，巴勒斯坦当局表示，以色列的一次重大空袭造成数十人死伤。

sentences.en: And North Carolina has become the second battleground state to set a record on the first day of early voting.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州已成为第二个在提前投票首日创下纪录的战场州。

sentences.en: Residents of the state cast more than 350,000 ballots on Thursday, and another 150,000 on Friday.
sentences.zh: 该州居民周四投出了超过35万张选票，周五又投出了15万张。

sentences.en: Earlier last week, first-day voting records were also shattered in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 上周早些时候，佐治亚州的投票首日纪录也被打破了。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卡洛斯·普列托、克莱尔·坦内斯凯特和罗布·齐普科制作。

sentences.zh: 由M.J.编辑。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。
